data.name: Major Aspect of the Monkey
data.description: Your shape changes to that of a Large monkey (as per the dire ape; Bestiary p17). While in this form, you gain a climb speed of %1 feet, low-light vision, and scent (30 feet), two claw attacks (1d6 damage), a bite attack (1d6 damage), and you can still use your hands to wield weapons, hold objects, and manipulate objects normally.|MonkeyAspectClimbSpeed

raw_tokens.value: Your shape changes to that of a Large monkey (as per the dire ape; Bestiary p17). While in this form, you gain a climb speed of %1 feet, low-light vision, and scent (30 feet), two claw attacks (1d6 damage), a bite attack (1d6 damage), and you can still use your hands to wield weapons, hold objects, and manipulate objects normally.|MonkeyAspectClimbSpeed
You can use your tail to hold and manipulate objects as if you had a third hand, but you cannot use it to wield weapons or shields.|PREVARGTEQ:ShifterMonkeyAspectLVL,8

You gain a rend attack that deals extra damage equal to that of your shifter claws attack plus 1-1/2 times your Strength bonus when you hit with two of your normal shifter claws attacks.|PREVARGTEQ:ShifterMonkeyAspectLVL,15
